name: Robert Eggers
bio: Robert Houston Eggers (born July 7, 1983) is an American filmmaker. After working for years as a production designer, he became known for writing and directing the period horror films The Witch (2015), The Lighthouse (2019), Nosferatu (2024) and Werwulf (2026) as well as co-writing and directing the Viking action film The Northman (2022). Noted for his attention to historical period detail, his films often incorporate elements of folklore and mythology.
place: New York City, New York, USA

credits.title: Untitled Labyrinth Sequel
credits.overview: Sequel set inside the weird fantasy realm of Jim Henson's Labyrinth. Plot TBA.

credits.title: Werwulf
credits.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

credits.title: Nosferatu: An Inside Look
credits.overview: An exclusive behind-the-scenes look “Nosferatu,” Robert Eggers’ gothic tale of obsession. Now playing exclusively in theaters.

credits.title: Nosferatu
credits.overview: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

credits.title: Art of Darkness: Making the Lighthouse
credits.overview: In-depth documentary featuring interviews with co-writer/director Robert Eggers and crew, plus authors Guy Adams and Alexandra Benedict.

credits.title: The Northman
credits.overview: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

credits.title: Woodlands Dark and Days Bewitched: A History of Folk Horror
credits.overview: An exploration of the cinematic history of the folk horror, from its beginnings in the UK in the late sixties; through its proliferation on British television in the seventies and its many manifestations, culturally specific, in other countries; to its resurgence in the last decade.

credits.title: The Lighthouse: A Dark & Stormy Tale
credits.overview: A look behind the scenes of Rober Eggers' film "The Lighthouse" (2019).

credits.title: The Lighthouse
credits.overview: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

credits.title: The Witch
credits.overview: In 1630, a farmer relocates his family to a remote plot of land on the edge of a forest where strange, unsettling things happen. With suspicion and paranoia mounting, each family member's faith, loyalty and love are tested in shocking ways.

credits.title: Brothers
credits.overview: The story of two brothers, Tom and Jake, and their problematic relationship.

credits.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
credits.overview: Within the chambers of a desolate house, a solitary servant tends to his invalid master. Tangibly detailed period design and hauntingly lifelike puppetry unearth the dreamworld of Poe.

credits.title: Hansel and Gretel
credits.overview: Based on the classic Brothers Grimm fairy tale, Hansel and Gretel is a dark and stylized, black and white, German Expressionistic silent picture featuring detailed design and an eerie musical score.
